1. Where is River Safari Nam Hoi An and how much are the tickets?
Address: River Safari Nam Hoi An is one of the five zones in the VinWonders Nam Hoi An entertainment and cultural experience complex, located on Vo Chi Cong Street, Thang An Commune, Da Nang City.
Admission to River Safari Nam Hoi An is included in the VinWonders Nam Hoi An amusement park ticket.

2. River Safari Nam Hoi An exploration itinerary
⏰ Experience duration: 30–35 minutes
🛶 Boats depart every 10–12 minutes, with a maximum of 26 guests per boat
🐵 Experience description: Visitors travel by boat along the river and observe hundreds of wild animals up close in a natural environment
2.1. Board the unique boat and get ready for an exciting adventure
Enjoy fresh air on a river journey and discover the fascinating lives of wild animals

At Safari Phu Quoc, visitors observe animals through the windows of specialized buses. River Safari Nam Hoi An offers an entirely different way to explore: relaxing aboard boats drifting along a 1.7-kilometer river while enjoying the fresh air. You can become a true explorer and discover rare wild animals living along both riverbanks.

River Safari Vinpearl Nam Hoi An currently conserves and breeds more than 500 animals representing 50 species. Thanks to an ideal habitat and excellent breeding conditions, the park welcomed more than 200 first-generation animal births within just over two years of operation.
2.2. Immerse yourself in the delightful world of waterfowl

The next stop on the journey is the “world of waterfowl.” As your boat glides gently along the river, you will encounter graceful “dancers” such as white swans, black swans, ruddy shelducks, and flamingos. The scenery makes a wonderful photo backdrop, so have your camera ready to capture these memorable moments.
2.3. Visit the kingdom of gentle herbivores

After exploring the world of waterfowl, the boat continues to a vast grassland kingdom inhabited by gentle herbivores such as greater kudu, oryx, scimitar-horned oryx, giraffes, spotted deer, zebras, and camels.

Here, you can stand close to giraffes, pet them, and feed them. You may also see camels capable of drinking 100 liters of water in just 10 minutes and adorable, round-bellied zebras. These friendly, active animals make it easy to enjoy playful interactions and take memorable photos.
2.4. Witness the lives of carnivorous animals up close
A River Safari Nam Hoi An journey would be incomplete without visiting the habitats of carnivores such as Bengal tigers, African lions, and Asiatic black bears.
An ideal habitat for carnivorous animals at River Safari Vinpearl Nam Hoi An

Dangerous predators with formidable survival instincts are no longer something you see only on a screen. At River Safari Nam Hoi An, you can witness these powerful animals roaring just a short distance away.

The friendly guides also share fascinating facts, such as why the lions can go without water for up to four days and how these “kings of the jungle” maintain their natural survival instincts within the wildlife conservation park.
2.5. Explore the “sanctuary” of primates, birds, and parrots

An essential part of River Safari’s wild world is the “sanctuary” of primates, birds, and parrots. They appear throughout the journey, from both riverbanks to the final stop. The lively movements of hundreds of gibbons and monkeys, birdsong, and brightly colored parrots make the experience even more exciting.

Beyond its vivid wildlife experiences, River Safari Nam Hoi An has become a social-media sensation thanks to Cao Viet Hoang, born in 2006, a part-time guide known for his good looks, bright smile, and friendly, engaging presentation style.

With his appealing appearance and lively commentary, Viet Hoang quickly became a “TikTok phenomenon,” attracting millions of views and positive interactions. Videos of him introducing animals, helping visitors take photos with River Safari mascots, and playfully interacting with guests have spread widely, creating a distinctive highlight for the nature journey.

Viet Hoang currently works at River Safari from Thursday through Sunday each week. When visiting VinWonders Nam Hoi An, do not miss the opportunity to meet the popular “Safari heartthrob” and capture memorable moments with wildlife and one of the attraction’s most inspiring young guides.

2. A roundup of the most spectacular VinWonders Nam Hoi An shows
2.1. Sailing Home Show

Sailing Home is a live spectacle inspired by the river life of hardworking fishermen whose difficult lives remain filled with optimism. It vividly recreates the joy of returning with a bountiful catch. Audiences are treated to a spectacular blend of music, props, and artistic choreography portraying the lives of fishermen in sun-drenched, windswept Central Vietnam.
The Sailing Home Show transports audiences to the 17th century through beautifully staged, slow-motion-like scenes
2.2. Quan Ho Singing

Journey through Vietnam’s cultural regions, enter the atmosphere of historic Kinh Bac, and meet traditional male and female singers performing heartfelt antiphonal love songs. The signature Quan Ho melodies of the Red River Delta are more than music: they preserve stories of love and traditional cultural beauty passed down through generations.
Enjoy the lyrical, soulful melodies of Quan Ho singing, expressing sincere and simple emotions
2.3. Chau Van & Then Singing

Chau Van singing, including the Co Doi Thuong Ngan ritual song, is a traditional Vietnamese vocal art associated with mediumship rituals in the Four Palaces belief and the worship of Saint Tran. The performance immerses visitors in an ancient cultural atmosphere.
Chau Van combines singing, instrumental music, and dance to create a rich and captivating performance

The program also features the sweet melodies of Then singing, Vietnam’s 13th form of intangible cultural heritage recognized by UNESCO. Then lyrics are refined from folk wisdom, combining lyrical, musical poetry with lessons on human relationships and conduct.
Then singing is a folk ritual of the Tay, Nung, and Thai peoples, with lyrics reflecting spiritual beliefs about humanity, the universe, and nature
2.4. Resonance of Majestic Mountains

This performance carries the spirit of the majestic Central Highlands, vividly recreating a fruitful forest journey by people of the highlands. The deep, imposing colors of the ancient forest are brought to life through a harmonious combination of music, props, and choreography. Traditional dances and resonant gong music create the atmosphere of a heroic epic.
The Resonance of Majestic Mountains Show is a vivid cultural portrait of the ethnic communities of the Central Highlands
2.5. Singing along the River

Singing along the River is one of VinWonders Nam Hoi An’s distinctive artistic programs, offering visitors a unique musical experience. Enjoy a lyrical atmosphere rich in folk color and immerse yourself in the tender, heartfelt folk songs of Vietnam’s three regions.
Singing along the River creates a unique and romantic musical experience

2.6. 3D Mapping Show – The Legends of Great Viet

Visitors can admire a spectacular projection on a structure modeled after Co Loa Citadel, retelling Vietnamese myths and legends across 4,000 years of history. The show uses impressive 3D mapping with a seamless combination of sound, lighting, and mesmerizing moving imagery.
Experience the story of Vietnam’s 4,000-year journey of nation-building and defense through brilliantly recreated ancient legends
2.7. Musical Water Fountain Show

The Musical Water Fountain Show delivers a spectacular visual feast through an elegant combination of energetic music, dazzling lighting, and graceful water choreography. Immerse yourself in a state-of-the-art stage featuring exceptional sound, light, fire, and water effects that create a rich range of emotions and multidimensional experiences.
The Musical Water Fountain Show is the perfect final piece in VinWonders Nam Hoi An’s unique cultural panorama

Visitors can enjoy eight distinctive shows: Sailing Home, Quan Ho Singing, Chau Van & Then Singing, Resonance of Majestic Mountains, Singing along the River, Cham Dance, the 3D Mapping Show – The Legends of Great Viet, and the Musical Water Fountain Show.
3.2. What is the VinWonders Nam Hoi An show schedule?
Shows are held daily, except the 3D Mapping and Musical Water Fountain shows, which run on Saturdays and Sundays. Specific times:
Sailing Home Show: 10:30 AM–11:00 AM
Quan Ho Singing: 2:15 PM–2:45 PM
Chau Van & Then Singing: 3:00 PM–3:20 PM

Show 3D Mapping: 18:30 – 18:45 (T7 & CN)
Musical Water Fountain Show: 6:50 PM–7:10 PM (Sat–Sun)
3.3. Where are the shows held within VinWonders Nam Hoi An?

Shows are presented across several zones: the Island of Folk Culture (Community Yard and Gong Stage), Harbor Corner (Eastern Street, riverside area, and Hill of Wishes), and the Musical Water Fountain Stage.
3.4. Is there an additional fee to watch shows at VinWonders Nam Hoi An?
No. All shows are free for visitors who purchase a VinWonders Nam Hoi An admission ticket.

VinWonders Nam Hoi An Island of Folk Culture – the perfect destination for an amazing heritage journey

The Island of Folk Culture in Hoi An is one of five zones within VinWonders Nam Hoi An, one of Central Vietnam’s leading entertainment and experience destinations. The zone preserves and faithfully recreates traditional cultural values, offering visitors a distinctive experience during their Hoi An journey.
1. Island of Folk Culture in Hoi An – A place to honor and preserve heritage values

The Island of Folk Culture is considered the heart of VinWonders Nam Hoi An, honoring and preserving heritage values. This charming island features the Craft Village Street, authentic architectural spaces from Northern to Southern Vietnam, the Hill of Wishes, Folk Art Square, Market Village, and the Community Yard, where distinctive traditional art forms are performed.
VinWonders Nam Hoi An operating hours: 9:00 AM–7:00 PM daily

2. What makes the Island of Folk Culture at VinWonders Nam Hoi An so appealing?
2.1. Explore traditional houses from Vietnam’s three regions at the Island of Folk Culture

The Island of Folk Culture in Hoi An recreates authentic homes from Vietnam’s three regions: North, Central, and South. Each structure features distinctive architecture connected to the culture and daily life of its region.
2.1.1. Northern Cultural Space

The Northern Cultural Space is surrounded by palm-covered hills and lush green tea gardens. The wooden houses feature intricate carvings. In particular, the pathway into this space evokes the famous folk tale “The Starfruit Tree.”
The historic atmosphere of traditional Northern Vietnamese houses
2.1.2. Central Cultural Space – Hue House

The Central Cultural Space at the Island of Folk Culture is built in the distinctive style of a traditional Hue Ruong house, with an entrance gate, shallow pond, spirit screen, three main compartments, and one side compartment. The house stands beside a lush fruit garden, with a lotus pond in front catching the breeze.
The Central Cultural Space – a Hue house with a shallow pond and breezy lotus pond
2.1.3. Central Highlands Cultural Space

The Central Highlands Cultural Space is vividly recreated with traditional Rong houses, Guol houses of the Co Tu people, and longhouses of the E De people. The surrounding landscape includes a flowing stream and tea fields, helping visitors better understand the life and customs of ethnic communities in the highlands.
2.1.4. Southern Cultural Space

At the Island of Folk Culture, the Southern Cultural Space is recreated in the Dinh-shaped architectural style and built from seven types of precious wood, symbolizing seven generations of a family lineage. The airy house blends harmoniously with nature and stands beside two Sa Dec brick kilns where visitors can experience pottery shaping and firing.
The Southern Cultural Space recreated at VinWonders Nam Hoi An’s Island of Folk Culture
2.2. Explore traditional craft villages
When visiting the Island of Folk Culture, stop by Craft Village Street to meet artisans, learn about traditional crafts, and create charming handmade souvenirs that commemorate your journey.
2.2.1. Experience do-paper craftsmanship

Do paper is made from the bark of the do tree. It is lightweight and porous, does not smudge when written on, resists moisture well, and can last up to 300 years. At the craft village, visitors can observe the elaborate papermaking process and receive guidance from artisans on forming sheets of do paper, printing Dong Ho paintings, or decorating the paper with playful masks.
Experience the intricate process of making do paper during your visit to the traditional craft village
2.2.2. Pottery making

Visitors can learn about pottery and hear stories about the craft from the Van Lang and Ly-Tran periods at the two Sa Dec brick kilns in the Southern house complex. They can also become “artisans” and shape their own small figurines, pottery vases, and other ceramic items.
Test your skill by making handcrafted pottery in the Southern Cultural Space
2.2.3. Thanh Tien paper flower making

This long-established craft comes from Thanh Tien Village in Hue, renowned for its exquisite and colorful decorative paper flowers. Visitors receive guidance on creating delicate Thanh Tien paper flower branches within the setting of a traditional Hue Ruong house.
Experience Thanh Tien paper flower making
2.2.4. Wood carving

Wood carving is vividly brought to life by the rhythmic sound of hammers and the fragrance of wood in the Northern Cultural Space. Skilled artisans use hammers, axes, and craftsmanship to transform raw timber into intricate forms. Visitors can also learn about carving techniques combined with inlay, mother-of-pearl, and distinctive lacquerwork.
Learn about wood carving under the guidance of skilled artisans
2.2.5. Silkworm farming, silk reeling, and silk weaving

The craft village offers a fascinating opportunity to watch silkworms spin silk on tender mulberry leaves. Traditional artisans guide visitors through silk reeling and weaving, allowing them to feel the softness of the finished products they help create.
Do not miss the experience of silk reeling and weaving during your craft village visit

2.3. Enjoy distinctive art performances

Beyond exploring the homes of Vietnam’s three regions and experiencing traditional craft villages, visitors to the Island of Folk Culture can enjoy distinctive art performances, including the Sailing Home live spectacle and traditional folk singing.
2.3.1. Watch the “Sailing Home” live spectacle
Location: Folk Art Square, Island of Folk Culture
Show time: 10:30 AM–11:00 AM

The “Sailing Home” live spectacle is inspired by Vietnamese daily life, customs, and traditions, telling an uplifting story of a bountiful return. Beyond its carefully developed narrative, the show combines props, music, and artistic choreography performed on boats, in the water, and in the air. Visitors experience a vibrant festival atmosphere and a wide range of emotions, from quiet reflection and amazement to the joy of reunion.
Hear the uplifting story of a bountiful return in the Sailing Home live spectacle
2.3.2. Enjoy traditional folk singing
Location: Community Yard

Do not miss the opportunity to experience UNESCO-recognized intangible cultural heritage at the Community Yard. Visitors can enjoy the gentle, heartfelt melodies of Quan Ho folk singing, the ceremonial music of the Co Doi Thuong Ngan Chau Van performance, and the distinctive rhythms of Then singing.
Enjoy distinctive traditional folk singing at the Community Yard
2.4. Shop for exquisite handcrafted souvenirs

During a journey through the Island of Folk Culture, visitors can purchase exquisite handicrafts created by talented artisans. These meaningful souvenirs preserve memories of the trip and make thoughtful gifts for loved ones.
Preserve travel memories with exquisite handicrafts sold at the Island of Folk Culture in Hoi An
2.5. Savor traditional cuisine at the “Market Village”

Market Village at the Island of Folk Culture is an ideal place to savor traditional cuisine from Vietnam’s three regions. Authentic and appealing dishes provide the energy needed to continue exploring and enjoying the park.
Savor the flavors of Vietnam’s three regions at Market Village

VinWonders Nam Hoi An Island of Folk Culture – the perfect destination for an amazing heritage journey

The Island of Folk Culture in Hoi An is one of five zones within VinWonders Nam Hoi An, one of Central Vietnam’s leading entertainment and experience destinations. The zone preserves and faithfully recreates traditional cultural values, offering visitors a distinctive experience during their Hoi An journey.
1. Island of Folk Culture in Hoi An – A place to honor and preserve heritage values

The Island of Folk Culture is considered the heart of VinWonders Nam Hoi An, honoring and preserving heritage values. This charming island features the Craft Village Street, authentic architectural spaces from Northern to Southern Vietnam, the Hill of Wishes, Folk Art Square, Market Village, and the Community Yard, where distinctive traditional art forms are performed.

2. What makes the Island of Folk Culture at VinWonders Nam Hoi An so appealing?
2.1. Explore traditional houses from Vietnam’s three regions at the Island of Folk Culture

The Island of Folk Culture in Hoi An recreates authentic homes from Vietnam’s three regions: North, Central, and South. Each structure features distinctive architecture connected to the culture and daily life of its region.
2.1.1. Northern Cultural Space

The Northern Cultural Space is surrounded by palm-covered hills and lush green tea gardens. The wooden houses feature intricate carvings. In particular, the pathway into this space evokes the famous folk tale “The Starfruit Tree.”
The historic atmosphere of traditional Northern Vietnamese houses
2.1.2. Central Cultural Space – Hue House

The Central Cultural Space at the Island of Folk Culture is built in the distinctive style of a traditional Hue Ruong house, with an entrance gate, shallow pond, spirit screen, three main compartments, and one side compartment. The house stands beside a lush fruit garden, with a lotus pond in front catching the breeze.
The Central Cultural Space – a Hue house with a shallow pond and breezy lotus pond
2.1.3. Central Highlands Cultural Space

The Central Highlands Cultural Space is vividly recreated with traditional Rong houses, Guol houses of the Co Tu people, and longhouses of the E De people. The surrounding landscape includes a flowing stream and tea fields, helping visitors better understand the life and customs of ethnic communities in the highlands.
2.1.4. Southern Cultural Space

At the Island of Folk Culture, the Southern Cultural Space is recreated in the Dinh-shaped architectural style and built from seven types of precious wood, symbolizing seven generations of a family lineage. The airy house blends harmoniously with nature and stands beside two Sa Dec brick kilns where visitors can experience pottery shaping and firing.
The Southern Cultural Space recreated at VinWonders Nam Hoi An’s Island of Folk Culture
2.2. Explore traditional craft villages
When visiting the Island of Folk Culture, stop by Craft Village Street to meet artisans, learn about traditional crafts, and create charming handmade souvenirs that commemorate your journey.
2.2.1. Experience do-paper craftsmanship

Do paper is made from the bark of the do tree. It is lightweight and porous, does not smudge when written on, resists moisture well, and can last up to 300 years. At the craft village, visitors can observe the elaborate papermaking process and receive guidance from artisans on forming sheets of do paper, printing Dong Ho paintings, or decorating the paper with playful masks.
Experience the intricate process of making do paper during your visit to the traditional craft village
2.2.2. Pottery making

Visitors can learn about pottery and hear stories about the craft from the Van Lang and Ly-Tran periods at the two Sa Dec brick kilns in the Southern house complex. They can also become “artisans” and shape their own small figurines, pottery vases, and other ceramic items.
Test your skill by making handcrafted pottery in the Southern Cultural Space
2.2.3. Thanh Tien paper flower making

This long-established craft comes from Thanh Tien Village in Hue, renowned for its exquisite and colorful decorative paper flowers. Visitors receive guidance on creating delicate Thanh Tien paper flower branches within the setting of a traditional Hue Ruong house.
Experience Thanh Tien paper flower making
2.2.4. Wood carving

Wood carving is vividly brought to life by the rhythmic sound of hammers and the fragrance of wood in the Northern Cultural Space. Skilled artisans use hammers, axes, and craftsmanship to transform raw timber into intricate forms. Visitors can also learn about carving techniques combined with inlay, mother-of-pearl, and distinctive lacquerwork.
Learn about wood carving under the guidance of skilled artisans
2.2.5. Silkworm farming, silk reeling, and silk weaving

The craft village offers a fascinating opportunity to watch silkworms spin silk on tender mulberry leaves. Traditional artisans guide visitors through silk reeling and weaving, allowing them to feel the softness of the finished products they help create.
Do not miss the experience of silk reeling and weaving during your craft village visit

2.3. Enjoy distinctive art performances

Beyond exploring the homes of Vietnam’s three regions and experiencing traditional craft villages, visitors to the Island of Folk Culture can enjoy distinctive art performances, including the Sailing Home live spectacle and traditional folk singing.
2.3.1. Watch the “Sailing Home” live spectacle
Location: Folk Art Square, Island of Folk Culture
Show time: 10:30 AM–11:00 AM

The “Sailing Home” live spectacle is inspired by Vietnamese daily life, customs, and traditions, telling an uplifting story of a bountiful return. Beyond its carefully developed narrative, the show combines props, music, and artistic choreography performed on boats, in the water, and in the air. Visitors experience a vibrant festival atmosphere and a wide range of emotions, from quiet reflection and amazement to the joy of reunion.
Hear the uplifting story of a bountiful return in the Sailing Home live spectacle
2.3.2. Enjoy traditional folk singing
Location: Community Yard

Do not miss the opportunity to experience UNESCO-recognized intangible cultural heritage at the Community Yard. Visitors can enjoy the gentle, heartfelt melodies of Quan Ho folk singing, the ceremonial music of the Co Doi Thuong Ngan Chau Van performance, and the distinctive rhythms of Then singing.
Enjoy distinctive traditional folk singing at the Community Yard
2.4. Shop for exquisite handcrafted souvenirs

During a journey through the Island of Folk Culture, visitors can purchase exquisite handicrafts created by talented artisans. These meaningful souvenirs preserve memories of the trip and make thoughtful gifts for loved ones.
Preserve travel memories with exquisite handicrafts sold at the Island of Folk Culture in Hoi An
2.5. Savor traditional cuisine at the “Market Village”

Market Village at the Island of Folk Culture is an ideal place to savor traditional cuisine from Vietnam’s three regions. Authentic and appealing dishes provide the energy needed to continue exploring and enjoying the park.

At the craft village, visitors can observe the elaborate papermaking process and receive guidance from artisans on forming sheets of do paper, printing Dong Ho paintings, or decorating the paper with playful masks.
Experience the intricate process of making do paper during your visit to the traditional craft village
2.2.2. Pottery making
Visitors can learn about pottery and hear stories about the craft from the Van Lang and Ly-Tran periods at the two Sa Dec brick kilns in the Southern house complex. They can also become “artisans” and shape their own small figurines, pottery vases, and other ceramic items.
Test your skill by making handcrafted pottery in the Southern Cultural Space
2.2.3. Thanh Tien paper flower making
This long-established craft comes from Thanh Tien Village in Hue, renowned for its exquisite and colorful decorative paper flowers. Visitors receive guidance on creating delicate Thanh Tien paper flower branches within the setting of a traditional Hue Ruong house.
Experience Thanh Tien paper flower making
2.2.4. Wood carving
Wood carving is vividly brought to life by the rhythmic sound of hammers and the fragrance of wood in the Northern Cultural Space. Skilled artisans use hammers, axes, and craftsmanship to transform raw timber into intricate forms. Visitors can also learn about carving techniques combined with inlay, mother-of-pearl, and distinctive lacquerwork.
Learn about wood carving under the guidance of skilled artisans
2.2.5. Silkworm farming, silk reeling, and silk weaving
The craft village offers a fascinating opportunity to watch silkworms spin silk on tender mulberry leaves. Traditional artisans guide visitors through silk reeling and weaving, allowing them to feel the softness of the finished products they help create.
Do not miss the experience of silk reeling and weaving during your craft village visit

2.3. Enjoy distinctive art performances
Beyond exploring the homes of Vietnam’s three regions and experiencing traditional craft villages, visitors to the Island of Folk Culture can enjoy distinctive art performances, including the Sailing Home live spectacle and traditional folk singing.
2.3.1. Watch the “Sailing Home” live spectacle
Location: Folk Art Square, Island of Folk Culture
Show time: 10:30 AM–11:00 AM
The “Sailing Home” live spectacle is inspired by Vietnamese daily life, customs, and traditions, telling an uplifting story of a bountiful return. Beyond its carefully developed narrative, the show combines props, music, and artistic choreography performed on boats, in the water, and in the air. Visitors experience a vibrant festival atmosphere and a wide range of emotions, from quiet reflection and amazement to the joy of reunion.
Hear the uplifting story of a bountiful return in the Sailing Home live spectacle
2.3.2. Enjoy traditional folk singing
Location: Community Yard
Do not miss the opportunity to experience UNESCO-recognized intangible cultural heritage at the Community Yard. Visitors can enjoy the gentle, heartfelt melodies of Quan Ho folk singing, the ceremonial music of the Co Doi Thuong Ngan Chau Van performance, and the distinctive rhythms of Then singing.
Enjoy distinctive traditional folk singing at the Community Yard
2.4. Shop for exquisite handcrafted souvenirs
During a journey through the Island of Folk Culture, visitors can purchase exquisite handicrafts created by talented artisans. These meaningful souvenirs preserve memories of the trip and make thoughtful gifts for loved ones.
Preserve travel memories with exquisite handicrafts sold at the Island of Folk Culture in Hoi An
2.5. Savor traditional cuisine at the “Market Village”
Market Village at the Island of Folk Culture is an ideal place to savor traditional cuisine from Vietnam’s three regions. Authentic and appealing dishes provide the energy needed to continue exploring and enjoying the park.
Savor the flavors of Vietnam’s three regions at Market Village

2. A roundup of the most spectacular VinWonders Nam Hoi An shows
2.1. Sailing Home Show

Sailing Home is a live spectacle inspired by the river life of hardworking fishermen whose difficult lives remain filled with optimism. It vividly recreates the joy of returning with a bountiful catch. Audiences are treated to a spectacular blend of music, props, and artistic choreography portraying the lives of fishermen in sun-drenched, windswept Central Vietnam.
The Sailing Home Show transports audiences to the 17th century through beautifully staged, slow-motion-like scenes
2.2. Quan Ho Singing

Journey through Vietnam’s cultural regions, enter the atmosphere of historic Kinh Bac, and meet traditional male and female singers performing heartfelt antiphonal love songs. The signature Quan Ho melodies of the Red River Delta are more than music: they preserve stories of love and traditional cultural beauty passed down through generations.
Enjoy the lyrical, soulful melodies of Quan Ho singing, expressing sincere and simple emotions
2.3. Chau Van & Then Singing

Chau Van singing, including the Co Doi Thuong Ngan ritual song, is a traditional Vietnamese vocal art associated with mediumship rituals in the Four Palaces belief and the worship of Saint Tran. The performance immerses visitors in an ancient cultural atmosphere.
Chau Van combines singing, instrumental music, and dance to create a rich and captivating performance

The program also features the sweet melodies of Then singing, Vietnam’s 13th form of intangible cultural heritage recognized by UNESCO. Then lyrics are refined from folk wisdom, combining lyrical, musical poetry with lessons on human relationships and conduct.
Then singing is a folk ritual of the Tay, Nung, and Thai peoples, with lyrics reflecting spiritual beliefs about humanity, the universe, and nature
2.4. Resonance of Majestic Mountains

This performance carries the spirit of the majestic Central Highlands, vividly recreating a fruitful forest journey by people of the highlands. The deep, imposing colors of the ancient forest are brought to life through a harmonious combination of music, props, and choreography. Traditional dances and resonant gong music create the atmosphere of a heroic epic.
The Resonance of Majestic Mountains Show is a vivid cultural portrait of the ethnic communities of the Central Highlands
2.5. Singing along the River

Singing along the River is one of VinWonders Nam Hoi An’s distinctive artistic programs, offering visitors a unique musical experience. Enjoy a lyrical atmosphere rich in folk color and immerse yourself in the tender, heartfelt folk songs of Vietnam’s three regions.
Singing along the River creates a unique and romantic musical experience

2.6. 3D Mapping Show – The Legends of Great Viet

Visitors can admire a spectacular projection on a structure modeled after Co Loa Citadel, retelling Vietnamese myths and legends across 4,000 years of history. The show uses impressive 3D mapping with a seamless combination of sound, lighting, and mesmerizing moving imagery.
Experience the story of Vietnam’s 4,000-year journey of nation-building and defense through brilliantly recreated ancient legends
2.7. Musical Water Fountain Show

The Musical Water Fountain Show delivers a spectacular visual feast through an elegant combination of energetic music, dazzling lighting, and graceful water choreography. Immerse yourself in a state-of-the-art stage featuring exceptional sound, light, fire, and water effects that create a rich range of emotions and multidimensional experiences.
The Musical Water Fountain Show is the perfect final piece in VinWonders Nam Hoi An’s unique cultural panorama

Shows are presented across several zones: the Island of Folk Culture (Community Yard and Gong Stage), Harbor Corner (Eastern Street, riverside area, and Hill of Wishes), and the Musical Water Fountain Stage.

2.1. Sailing Home Show
Sailing Home is a live spectacle inspired by the river life of hardworking fishermen whose difficult lives remain filled with optimism. It vividly recreates the joy of returning with a bountiful catch. Audiences are treated to a spectacular blend of music, props, and artistic choreography portraying the lives of fishermen in sun-drenched, windswept Central Vietnam.
The Sailing Home Show transports audiences to the 17th century through beautifully staged, slow-motion-like scenes
2.2. Quan Ho Singing
Journey through Vietnam’s cultural regions, enter the atmosphere of historic Kinh Bac, and meet traditional male and female singers performing heartfelt antiphonal love songs. The signature Quan Ho melodies of the Red River Delta are more than music: they preserve stories of love and traditional cultural beauty passed down through generations.
Enjoy the lyrical, soulful melodies of Quan Ho singing, expressing sincere and simple emotions
2.3. Chau Van & Then Singing
Chau Van singing, including the Co Doi Thuong Ngan ritual song, is a traditional Vietnamese vocal art associated with mediumship rituals in the Four Palaces belief and the worship of Saint Tran. The performance immerses visitors in an ancient cultural atmosphere.
Chau Van combines singing, instrumental music, and dance to create a rich and captivating performance
The program also features the sweet melodies of Then singing, Vietnam’s 13th form of intangible cultural heritage recognized by UNESCO. Then lyrics are refined from folk wisdom, combining lyrical, musical poetry with lessons on human relationships and conduct.
Then singing is a folk ritual of the Tay, Nung, and Thai peoples, with lyrics reflecting spiritual beliefs about humanity, the universe, and nature
2.4. Resonance of Majestic Mountains
This performance carries the spirit of the majestic Central Highlands, vividly recreating a fruitful forest journey by people of the highlands. The deep, imposing colors of the ancient forest are brought to life through a harmonious combination of music, props, and choreography. Traditional dances and resonant gong music create the atmosphere of a heroic epic.
The Resonance of Majestic Mountains Show is a vivid cultural portrait of the ethnic communities of the Central Highlands
2.5. Singing along the River

Singing along the River creates a unique and romantic musical experience

Experience the story of Vietnam’s 4,000-year journey of nation-building and defense through brilliantly recreated ancient legends
2.7. Musical Water Fountain Show
The Musical Water Fountain Show delivers a spectacular visual feast through an elegant combination of energetic music, dazzling lighting, and graceful water choreography. Immerse yourself in a state-of-the-art stage featuring exceptional sound, light, fire, and water effects that create a rich range of emotions and multidimensional experiences.
The Musical Water Fountain Show is the perfect final piece in VinWonders Nam Hoi An’s unique cultural panorama

According to VinWonders Nam Hoi An reviews, Water World is an unmissable zone packed with fun. It includes swimming areas, family attractions, children’s play areas, and more, making it suitable for every member of the family.
2.1. Experience a thrilling ride on the Boomerang Slide

The Boomerang Slide at VinWonders Nam Hoi An Water Park is one of Vietnam’s most exciting water slides. At 55 meters long, it is designed for groups of four. Visitors can scream, release stress, and enjoy the thrill with friends and family.
The Boomerang Slide is a visitor favorite
2.2. Try the unique Middle Bowl Slide
The Middle Bowl Slide sends riders into continuous high-speed spins above the ground. Resembling a giant 18-meter-wide black hole, it creates the sensation of riding powerful, rolling waves.
The Middle Bowl Slide at VinWonders Nam Hoi An Water Park
2.3. Conquer the Dragon Slide

On the Dragon Slide, visitors can free-fall through enclosed tubes. Standing 12 meters high and stretching 120 meters through twisting curves, the attraction promises an exciting experience for couples and groups of friends.
2.4. Drift along the Lazy River

The Lazy River is one of the most frequently recommended attractions in reviews of VinWonders Nam Hoi An Water Park. Visitors can cool off, lie on inflatable tubes, and drift along the clear blue river.
Simply relax and let the current carry you through different areas of the water park. This attraction is suitable for visitors of all ages and every member of the family.
Drift along the Lazy River
2.5. Have fun with friends in the Wave Pool
The shell-shaped Wave Pool is another unmissable attraction. Visitors can dive, swim, and play among different wave levels, ranging from gentle and calm to powerful and energetic.

2.6. Tornado Slide

The next attraction on the VinWonders Nam Hoi An map is the Tornado Slide. Resembling a giant whirlwind, it sends riders on an adventure through a large funnel, spinning rapidly before splashing into cool water. The attraction is suitable for groups of two to four visitors.
The giant Tornado Slide excites visitors
2.7. High-Speed Slide
The High-Speed Slide is a favorite among speed enthusiasts. Riders race through four intertwining spiral lanes. This attraction is ideal for young visitors who enjoy thrills and adventure.

Hoi An shows are among the experiences most frequently chosen by visitors alongside sightseeing and exploring the heritage destination. This article reviews ten impressive performances that should not be missed during a Hoi An trip.
1. Shows at VinWonders Nam Hoi An

VinWonders Nam Hoi An is one of Central Vietnam’s leading entertainment, recreation, and cultural-exploration complexes. It hosts the distinctive Sailing Home live spectacle and many engaging folk-art programs.
Reference ticket price: Admission to the shows at VinWonders Nam Hoi An is included in the park entrance ticket. The current 2026 VinWonders Nam Hoi An ticket prices are as follows:

1.1. Sailing Home Live Spectacle
Performance location: Folk Art Square
Reference show time: 10:30 AM–11:00 AM

The Sailing Home Hoi An show is a live spectacle inspired by Vietnamese folk life, customs, and traditions. Through a seamless combination of music, props, and artistic choreography on the waterfront and aboard boats, it recreates the joy of returning with a bountiful catch. The performance takes audiences through a full range of emotions, from quiet reflection and amazement to the overflowing joy of reunion.
Sailing Home Live Spectacle
1.2. 3D Mapping Show – The Legends of Great Viet
Performance location: Hill of Wishes, Island of Folk Culture, VinWonders Nam Hoi An
Reference show time: 6:30 PM–6:45 PM (Saturday & Sunday)

The Hill of Wishes, a structure modeled after Co Loa Citadel, hosts a spectacular 3D Mapping Show. Through vivid and sharply rendered imagery, the performance retells Vietnamese myths and legends spanning 4,000 years, including Saint Giong, the origin of banh chung and banh giay, and the legend of Lac Long Quan and Au Co.
The 3D Mapping Show – The Legends of Great Viet recreates Vietnamese myths and legends at the Hill of Wishes
1.3. Musical Water Fountain Show
Performance location: Musical Water Fountain Stage
Reference show time: 6:50 PM–7:10 PM (Saturday & Sunday)

A journey through entertainment and cultural discovery at VinWonders Nam Hoi An concludes perfectly with the colorful Musical Water Fountain Show. Combining water, light, and music, this Hoi An performance delivers a rich emotional experience that delights both the eyes and ears.
The Musical Water Fountain Show provides a memorable finale to a day of entertainment at VinWonders Nam Hoi An
1.4. UNESCO-Recognized Performance – Chau Van
Performance location: Community Yard – VinWonders Nam Hoi An
Reference show time: 3:00 PM–3:20 PM

At VinWonders Nam Hoi An, do not miss Chau Van, a ceremonial musical tradition of the Northern Delta associated with mediumship rituals in the Four Palaces Mother Goddess belief. In 2016, this folk ritual music was recognized by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage.
Visitors enjoy Chau Van, a form of folk ritual music recognized by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage
1.5. Quan Ho Singing
Performance location: Riverside Ancient Town
Reference show time: 2:15 PM–2:45 PM

Quan Ho is a renowned antiphonal singing tradition of the Red River Delta. At VinWonders Nam Hoi An’s Community Yard, it is authentically recreated through heartfelt, simple, and unadorned lyrics performed without instrumental accompaniment.
Listen to the heartfelt and unadorned lyrics of Quan Ho antiphonal singing
1.6. Then Singing
Performance location: Community Yard

Then singing is a folk ritual of the Tay, Nung, and Thai peoples, with lyrics reflecting spiritual beliefs about humanity, the universe, and nature. By enjoying Then singing at VinWonders, visitors can appreciate the spiritual beauty of Northern Vietnam’s ethnic communities.
Then singing in Hoi An – a folk ritual of the Tay, Nung, and Thai peoples authentically recreated at the Community Yard

2. A O Show – A Unique and Captivating Hoi An Performance

A O Show is a distinctive art production performed in Hoi An, which is now administratively part of Da Nang City following the merger, Ho Chi Minh City, and more than 15 countries worldwide. The show blends images of rural Vietnam with the youthful, bustling energy of an urbanizing nation. Combining bamboo circus, dance, aerial acrobatics, and performances on 17 musical instruments, A O Show paints a vivid picture of everyday life with witty and subtle humor.
A O Show’s unique “storytelling circus” performance (Photo: Lune Production)
3. Water Puppet Show – A Hoi An Performance Rich in Folk Culture

Hoi An water puppetry not only preserves the beauty of a traditional art form but also incorporates performances reflecting Quang-region culture, including the Four Sacred Animals dance, Apsara dance, the Tran Cu legend, dragon dance, boat racing, and the Eight Immortals dance. Many visitors choose this show to deepen their understanding of the heritage region’s culture and enjoy a relaxing evening.
Enjoy the Hoi An Water Puppet Show, an ideal evening activity in the ancient town (Photo: collected)

4. Teh Dar Show – An Impressive Re-creation of Central Highlands Culture

On a contemporary stage, Hoi An’s Teh Dar Show vividly and authentically recreates Central Highlands culture while conveying humanistic values amid the cycles of life. It evokes the mystical atmosphere of the ancient forest, with death and rebirth, hunting journeys, and moonlit courtship. The performance captivates audiences through bamboo circus techniques, daring acrobatics, and the resonant sounds of gongs, horns, flutes, and traditional stringed instruments.
Teh Dar Show in Hoi An – a vivid and authentic recreation of Central Highlands culture (Photo: Lune Production)

5.2. How can visitors watch the Sailing Home and 3D Mapping shows at VinWonders Nam Hoi An?

These shows are included in the admission ticket. Sailing Home is usually performed at 10:30 AM daily at Folk Art Square in the Island of Folk Culture, while the 3D Mapping Show begins at 6:30 PM on Saturdays and Sundays at the Hill of Wishes. Check the VinWonders app for the latest schedule.
5.3. Is there a fee to watch traditional art performances in Hoi An Ancient Town?

Most traditional musical-instrument performances and Bai Choi singing sessions in Hoi An Ancient Town are free for visitors holding an ancient-town admission ticket. They are presented periodically at historic houses or outdoor stages along the Hoai River.

1.1. Sailing Home Live Spectacle
Performance location: Folk Art Square
Reference show time: 10:30 AM–11:00 AM
The Sailing Home Hoi An show is a live spectacle inspired by Vietnamese folk life, customs, and traditions. Through a seamless combination of music, props, and artistic choreography on the waterfront and aboard boats, it recreates the joy of returning with a bountiful catch. The performance takes audiences through a full range of emotions, from quiet reflection and amazement to the overflowing joy of reunion.
Sailing Home Live Spectacle
1.2. 3D Mapping Show – The Legends of Great Viet
Performance location: Hill of Wishes, Island of Folk Culture, VinWonders Nam Hoi An
Reference show time: 6:30 PM–6:45 PM (Saturday & Sunday)
The Hill of Wishes, a structure modeled after Co Loa Citadel, hosts a spectacular 3D Mapping Show. Through vivid and sharply rendered imagery, the performance retells Vietnamese myths and legends spanning 4,000 years, including Saint Giong, the origin of banh chung and banh giay, and the legend of Lac Long Quan and Au Co.
The 3D Mapping Show – The Legends of Great Viet recreates Vietnamese myths and legends at the Hill of Wishes
1.3. Musical Water Fountain Show
Performance location: Musical Water Fountain Stage
Reference show time: 6:50 PM–7:10 PM (Saturday & Sunday)
A journey through entertainment and cultural discovery at VinWonders Nam Hoi An concludes perfectly with the colorful Musical Water Fountain Show. Combining water, light, and music, this Hoi An performance delivers a rich emotional experience that delights both the eyes and ears.
The Musical Water Fountain Show provides a memorable finale to a day of entertainment at VinWonders Nam Hoi An
1.4. UNESCO-Recognized Performance – Chau Van
Performance location: Community Yard – VinWonders Nam Hoi An
Reference show time: 3:00 PM–3:20 PM
At VinWonders Nam Hoi An, do not miss Chau Van, a ceremonial musical tradition of the Northern Delta associated with mediumship rituals in the Four Palaces Mother Goddess belief. In 2016, this folk ritual music was recognized by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage.
Visitors enjoy Chau Van, a form of folk ritual music recognized by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage
1.5. Quan Ho Singing
Performance location: Riverside Ancient Town
Reference show time: 2:15 PM–2:45 PM
Quan Ho is a renowned antiphonal singing tradition of the Red River Delta. At VinWonders Nam Hoi An’s Community Yard, it is authentically recreated through heartfelt, simple, and unadorned lyrics performed without instrumental accompaniment.
Listen to the heartfelt and unadorned lyrics of Quan Ho antiphonal singing
1.6. Then Singing
Performance location: Community Yard
Then singing is a folk ritual of the Tay, Nung, and Thai peoples, with lyrics reflecting spiritual beliefs about humanity, the universe, and nature. By enjoying Then singing at VinWonders, visitors can appreciate the spiritual beauty of Northern Vietnam’s ethnic communities.

2. A O Show – A Unique and Captivating Hoi An Performance
A O Show is a distinctive art production performed in Hoi An, which is now administratively part of Da Nang City following the merger, Ho Chi Minh City, and more than 15 countries worldwide. The show blends images of rural Vietnam with the youthful, bustling energy of an urbanizing nation. Combining bamboo circus, dance, aerial acrobatics, and performances on 17 musical instruments, A O Show paints a vivid picture of everyday life with witty and subtle humor.
A O Show’s unique “storytelling circus” performance (Photo: Lune Production)
3. Water Puppet Show – A Hoi An Performance Rich in Folk Culture
Hoi An water puppetry not only preserves the beauty of a traditional art form but also incorporates performances reflecting Quang-region culture, including the Four Sacred Animals dance, Apsara dance, the Tran Cu legend, dragon dance, boat racing, and the Eight Immortals dance. Many visitors choose this show to deepen their understanding of the heritage region’s culture and enjoy a relaxing evening.

4. Teh Dar Show – An Impressive Re-creation of Central Highlands Culture
On a contemporary stage, Hoi An’s Teh Dar Show vividly and authentically recreates Central Highlands culture while conveying humanistic values amid the cycles of life. It evokes the mystical atmosphere of the ancient forest, with death and rebirth, hunting journeys, and moonlit courtship. The performance captivates audiences through bamboo circus techniques, daring acrobatics, and the resonant sounds of gongs, horns, flutes, and traditional stringed instruments.

5.2. How can visitors watch the Sailing Home and 3D Mapping shows at VinWonders Nam Hoi An?
These shows are included in the admission ticket. Sailing Home is usually performed at 10:30 AM daily at Folk Art Square in the Island of Folk Culture, while the 3D Mapping Show begins at 6:30 PM on Saturdays and Sundays at the Hill of Wishes. Check the VinWonders app for the latest schedule.
5.3. Is there a fee to watch traditional art performances in Hoi An Ancient Town?
Most traditional musical-instrument performances and Bai Choi singing sessions in Hoi An Ancient Town are free for visitors holding an ancient-town admission ticket. They are presented periodically at historic houses or outdoor stages along the Hoai River.
